purpose: Exploratory matched three-arm portfolio comparison across six universes; constituent-stock proxy versus signal-free constituent control and actual ETF basket, NOT canonical ETF alpha or independent confirmation.

universes.definition: Lagged QC-covered US-equity SPY constituents; S&P500 ETF proxy, not broader all-US-largecap index or unbiased official-index replication.
Lagged QC-covered US-equity XLV constituents: S&P500 healthcare, not all healthcare stocks.
Lagged QC-covered US-equity XLE constituents: S&P500 energy, not all clean/renewable energy stocks.
Lagged QC-covered US-equity QQQ constituents: Nasdaq100 proxy, NOT all Nasdaq-listed stocks.
Lagged QC-covered US-equity SOXX constituents: semiconductor manufacturing/equipment, not broad technology.
Lagged QC-covered US-equity REMX slice; incomplete global rare-earth/strategic-metals exposure, not broad mining/gold/uranium. The ETF basket trades full REMX ETF, unlike constituent controls.

membership.source: QuantConnect US ETF Constituents / Security Master, cloud simulated receipt clocks; no verified historical publication vintage.
membership.rule: Latest snapshot received by prior-session 18:00NY cutoff and effective7–21calendar days earlier; no future receipts.
membership.unknown: Missing member weights, identity/signal states or snapshots retained distinctly; not zero signals; incomplete callback slice never renormalized to full global holdings.
membership.overlap: Six sleeves overlap; consolidate exact native Symbol identities; account P&L only, not independently invented sleeve returns.
membership.missing_snapshot: Stock arms refuse the whole decision if any sleeve's lagged snapshot is missing, consistently for ON/OFF; incomplete global weight is recorded, not equated to no snapshot. ETF basket fixed instruments do not depend on constituent snapshots; missing callback is context-only diagnostic, not an invented ETF execution gate.

arms.selection: Same historical frozen raw nominal target-price revision scores, positive top10 per sleeve, native source-ID tie-break; no price/liquidity substitution; explicit source-identity missing/refused/ineligible states.
arms.weights: Each selected sleeve slot1/60 of prior-close NAV; aggregate exact native Symbol identity across sleeves, at most10% for six overlapping slots; unselected slots remain cash.

arms.selection: Top10 positive known lagged ETF holding weights, descending weight then native SymbolID; no TPR packet read, source identity, signal coverage, score, eligibility, ranking, weights or fallback dependence.
arms.weights: Same1/60 per slot, consolidation, volume/cash/accounting constraints; missing slots cash. Non-signal membership rules identical; removes TPR signal/source-admission effects jointly, not pure weight-only ablation.

arms.selection: All six fixed ETFs; no TPR or AR inputs; actual orders.
arms.weights: Each ETF1/6 prior-close NAV; deliberate ETF position-cap difference from10% individual stock aggregate. Same fees/slippage, whole shares, volume cap and cash buffer. No stock fallback.

analyst_revisions: Completely disabled; no AR import, score, eligibility, selection, ranking, weights or fallback. AR historical dates/capital/QCOM exclusion/caps/fees/timing are attributed notes not adopted approval.

economics.rebalance: Same14 weekly first-session dates/cutoffs as immutable original packet.
economics.execution: MOO09:20NY; cancel remaining09:35; no daily retry or anticipated sale proceeds.
economics.sizing: Whole-share floor of frozen weight*prior-close NAV/current-split-basis prior close. Sell-first; target weights are PRIOR-CLOSE SOFT TARGETS, not guaranteed execution-time namecaps.
economics.cost_order: All3 baseline runs before predefined5bps-additional adverse runs; no tuning between arms/costs.
economics.volume_cap: 1% prior completed-session raw shares, pre-cap submitted quantity; requested-minus-submitted explicit capacity shortfall, not partial fill.
economics.cash_buffer: 97% of preexisting cash budget including fee/slippage;3%gapbuffer; leverage1; actual opening rejection not concealed.
economics.corporate_actions: RAW native actions; maintain admitted membership subscriptions/custody before cutoff; refuse unknown action basis rather than default missing split=1; explicit delisting/order-failure diagnostics; immediate dividends/settlement.
economics.risk: Longonly/unlevered cash nonnegative, gross<=1 with penny accounting tolerance. Open gaps can change individual weights; report target vs realized economics, never silently reinterpret targetcap as hard.
